content.title: SIGNS YOUR BODY IS QUIETLY RUNNING ON EMPTY
facts: **Iodine** – Puffy face, constant fatigue, feeling cold all the time, and an unexplained weight gain.
**Vitamin A** – Trouble seeing in dim light, dry itchy eyes, and rough bumpy patches on the skin.
**Folate** – Persistent tiredness, pale skin, mouth sores, and trouble concentrating.
**Vitamin E** – Muscle weakness, poor balance, and numbness or tingling in the limbs.
**Omega-3** – Dry flaky skin, brittle nails, joint stiffness, and trouble focusing.
**Vitamin C** – Bleeding gums, slow-healing cuts, easy bruising, and constant joint pain.
**Vitamin D** – Bone aches, low mood in winter months, and getting sick more often than usual.
**Vitamin B12** – Tingling in hands/feet, weakness, memory problems, and low mood.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
A folate shortage often shows up as pale skin and constant tiredness because folate is essential for making healthy red blood cells that carry oxygen through your body — without enough, your cells simply run out of fuel. Low vitamin E can quietly weaken your muscles and throw off your balance since it protects nerve membranes from damage, and over time that protective layer starts to break down. And an iodine gap can leave you feeling cold and puffy because your thyroid depends on iodine to produce the hormones that control your metabolism — without it, everything slows down. Everyone's body is different, so listen to yours and don't ignore patterns that keep repeating.
